title: 118. How do I bulk delete answers from survey results?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How do I bulk delete answers from survey results.
short_answer: You can delete an entire column from your survey results. This will have the effect of 'emptying' (i.e. permanently deleting) all responses to the corresponding question. This can be useful for anonymizing results, for example in the context of GDPR compliance.
procedure: 1. Go to the 'Results' tab. 2. Find the column for which you want to delete the answers in bulk. 3. Click on the 3 dots icon. 4. Select 'Blank answers'. 5. Confirm the deletion.
All answers collected for the corresponding question will be permanently removed.
